This FloPlast solvent weld 135° single socket bottom offset bend provides a reliable solution for redirecting soil and vent drainage systems. Constructed from durable uPVC, it ensures a secure and watertight connection when used with solvent weld joints, essential for robust plumbing installations. The 110mm pipe diameter is standard for many drainage projects, offering a compact method to navigate obstructions or change pipe direction. Its grey finish allows for discreet integration within various building aesthetics, making it a practical choice for plumbers and drainage specialists requiring precise angle adjustments.
